description: This file defines a helper class VarDefHelper within the Api\V8\Helper namespace. The class contains a method getAllRelationships that retrieves related modules of a given SugarBean object by examining its linked fields and loaded relationships.

classes.name: VarDefHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to retrieve relationship information from a SugarBean object.

methods.name: getAllRelationships
methods.description: Returns an array of related module names for the given SugarBean object by inspecting linked fields and loaded relationships.
